key.name: acceleration
key.summary: Progressive distance acceleration; zero turns the curve off

key.name: direction-threshold
key.summary: Movement, in counts at 1000 DPI, before a hold picks horizontal or overview

key.name: switch-threshold-percent
key.summary: How far, in percent of a step, a released gesture must have gone to switch

key.name: flick-enabled
key.summary: Experimental: a quick movement that is still fast at release switches however far it went

key.name: flick-min-speed
key.summary: Speed, in millimetres per second, a movement must reach to count as a flick

key.name: flick-keep-percent
key.summary: After its fastest moment, a flick must keep at least this percent of that speed until release

key.name: natural-workspace-direction
key.summary: Reverse the horizontal workspace slide relative to mouse movement

key.name: release-deadtime-ms
key.summary: Pointer hold after releasing the button, in milliseconds

key.name: listen-all-buttons
key.summary: Glide with every button that Solaar streams

key.name: selected-buttons
key.summary: Buttons to glide with when listen-all-buttons is off, as "unitId:control"

key.name: seen-buttons
key.summary: Buttons that have sent Movement Stream signals, as "unitId:control"

key.name: known-devices
key.summary: Devices and buttons from the last Solaar scan (JSON), shown while disconnected

key.name: debug-progress
key.summary: Show the gesture progress badge and detailed logs
